command:
set -euo pipefail
export PATH=/opt/conda/bin:$PATH
export TMPDIR=/tmp HOME=/tmp
cd /tmp

SV=$(stringtie --version 2>&1 | awk 'NR==1{print $1}')
echo "== assemble de novo: NO reference annotation is given to StringTie =="
stringtie -o assembled.gtf -l ASM sample.bam > st.log 2>&1 || { cat st.log; exit 1; }
awk -F'\t' '$3=="exon" || $3=="transcript"' assembled.gtf | cut -f3,4,5,7

NTR=$(awk -F'\t' '$3=="transcript"{n++} END{print n+0}' assembled.gtf)
test "$NTR" = "1" || { echo "expected 1 assembled transcript, got $NTR"; exit 1; }
awk -F'\t' '$3=="exon"{print $4"\t"$5}' assembled.gtf | sort -k1,1n > asm_exons.tsv
NEX=$(awk 'END{print NR+0}' asm_exons.tsv)
test "$NEX" = "3" || { echo "expected 3 exons, got $NEX"; exit 1; }

echo "== the intron chain StringTie built, and the one that was planted =="
awk 'NR>1{print prev+1"\t"$1-1} {prev=$2}' asm_exons.tsv > asm_introns.tsv
paste truth_introns.tsv asm_introns.tsv
diff -q truth_introns.tsv asm_introns.tsv > /dev/null \
  || { echo "intron chain differs from the planted one:"; diff truth_introns.tsv asm_introns.tsv; exit 1; }

echo "== boundaries: internal exons and the 3' end exact; the 5' terminus is TRIMMED inward =="
read -r A1S A1E < <(awk 'NR==1' asm_exons.tsv)
read -r A2S A2E < <(awk 'NR==2' asm_exons.tsv)
read -r A3S A3E < <(awk 'NR==3' asm_exons.tsv)
read -r T1S T1E < <(awk 'NR==1' truth_exons.tsv)
read -r T2S T2E < <(awk 'NR==2' truth_exons.tsv)
read -r T3S T3E < <(awk 'NR==3' truth_exons.tsv)
test "$A2S" = "$T2S" && test "$A2E" = "$T2E" || { echo "internal exon is not exact"; exit 1; }
test "$A1E" = "$T1E" || { echo "exon1 3' boundary (a splice site) is not exact"; exit 1; }
test "$A3S" = "$T3S" || { echo "exon3 5' boundary (a splice site) is not exact"; exit 1; }
test "$A3E" = "$T3E" || { echo "exon3 3' end is not exact"; exit 1; }
# directional: a terminus may be trimmed INWARD but never extended past the truth
test "$A1S" -ge "$T1S" || { echo "exon1 extends beyond the planted gene ($A1S < $T1S)"; exit 1; }
TRIM=$(( A1S - T1S ))
ASMLEN=$(awk '{n += $2-$1+1} END{print n}' asm_exons.tsv)

{
printf 'Transcript assembly -- a 3-exon gene reassembled from spliced reads\n'
printf 'stringtie_version\t%s\n' "$SV"
printf 'transcripts\t%s   (assert 1)\n' "$NTR"
printf 'exons\t%s   (assert 3)\n' "$NEX"
printf 'intron_chain_exact\tyes   (assert yes -- EXACT: 1301-2500 and 2701-4000)\n'
printf 'internal_exon_exact\tyes   (assert yes -- %s-%s)\n' "$A2S" "$A2E"
printf 'splice_boundaries_exact\tyes   (assert yes -- every exon edge that is a SPLICE SITE)\n'
printf 'three_prime_end_exact\tyes   (assert yes -- %s)\n' "$A3E"
printf 'five_prime_trim\t%s bp   (assembled %s vs planted %s -- trimmed INWARD, asserted never outward)\n' "$TRIM" "$A1S" "$T1S"
printf 'assembled_exonic_len\t%s of 900 bp\n' "$ASMLEN"
printf 'note\tassembly determines the INTRON CHAIN precisely and the transcript TERMINI only\n'
printf 'note\tapproximately: coverage ramps up at the 5-prime end, so StringTie trims where it drops.\n'
printf 'note\tThat is why the assertion is the intron chain plus DIRECTIONAL containment at the ends.\n'
} | tee smoke-check-stringtie.txt
echo "ASSEMBLY CHECK PASSED"
